prompt: Plan tomorrow for a roofing crew at site A.
answer:
### Risk Summary
**Tomorrow's Risk Level:** Extreme heat risk with a peak temperature of 45 °C, peak WBGT of 40 °C, and 11 hours in the High TWL zone in the sun. A heat programme is required.

*Note: Thermal Work Limit (TWL) values derived from forecast data are estimates.*

---

### Hour-by-Hour Work Plan (Mussafah / Site A)
*Assumptions: Acclimatised crew, no shade available, 6 hours (360 minutes) of outdoor work needed.*

| Time | TWL Zone | Work/Rest Schedule | Scheduled Work Minutes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **05:00 - 06:00** | Low | continuous self-paced | 60 |
| **06:00 - 07:00** | Medium | 45 min work / 15 min rest (paced work) | 45 |
| **07:00 - 08:00** | High | 20 min work / 40 min rest | 20 |
| **08:00 - 09:00** | High | 20 min work / 40 min rest | 20 |
| **09:00 - 10:00** | High | 20 min work / 40 min rest | 20 |
| **10:00 - 11:00** | High | 20 min work / 40 min rest | 20 |
| **11:00 - 12:00** | High | 20 min work / 40 min rest | 20 |
| **12:00 - 13:00** | High | 20 min work / 40 min rest *(outdoor work must end by 12:30)* | 10 |
| **13:00 - 14:00** | High | **Midday Break (No outdoor work)** | 0 |
| **14:00 - 15:00** | High | **Midday Break (No outdoor work)** | 0 |
| **15:00 - 16:00** | High | 20 min work / 40 min rest | 20 |
| **16:00 - 17:00** | High | 20 min work / 40 min rest | 20 |
| **17:00 - 18:00** | High | 20 min work / 40 min rest | 20 |
| **18:00 - 19:00** | Medium | 45 min work / 15 min rest (paced work) | 45 |

---

### Midday Break
* **Duration:** 12:30 - 15:00.
* **Rule:** No outdoor work is permitted. Work in the 12:00 - 13:00 hour must stop completely by 12:30.

---

### Fluid Requirements
* **Low Zone (05:00 - 06:00):** 0.6-1.0 (light work) litres per hour.
* **Medium Zone (06:00 - 07:00, 18:00 - 19:00):** 1.0-1.2 light; >1.2 heavy litres per hour.
* **High Zone (07:00 - 12:30, 15:00 - 18:00):** >1.2 all work litres per hour.

---

### Required Zone Controls
#### Low Zone Controls
* No limits on self-paced work for educated, hydrated workers

#### Medium Zone Controls
* Engineering controls to reduce heat stress (shade, ventilation)
* Working alone to be avoided
* No unacclimatised person to work
* Ensure adequate fluid intake for the type of work

#### High Zone Controls
* Strict work/rest cycling required
* No person to work alone
* No unacclimatised person to work
* High Risk induction: hydration and signs of heat strain
* Personal water bottle (2 litre) on site at all times

*Note: Unacclimatised workers (any crew member who is new or returning after more than 14 days off) are restricted to working only in the Low zone (05:00 - 06:00).*

---

### Shortfall
* **Work Hours Needed:** 360 minutes (6 hours)
* **Work Hours Scheduled:** 320 minutes
* **Shortfall:** 40 minutes. *Do not extend work hours beyond this schedule to make up the shortfall, as it is unsafe to do so.*

---

### Citations
* ADOSH-SF Technical Guideline, Safety in the Heat, v4.0 (15 Jul 2024), Table 1, p.5
* ADOSH-SF CoP 11.0, Safety in the Heat, v4.0 (Jul 2024)
* MoHRE Midday Break announcement
